evidence.meaning: The sole aircraft allocated to this tailored FCOM is MSN2078 / HC-CLF / 319-112.
J0071: wing tip incorporating a tip fence.
AAT defines the fleet covered by this FCOM.
Engine equivalence list maps A319-112 to CFM56-5B6; it is not an expansion of numerical table applicability.
Embedded table footer explicitly identifies A319-112 CFM56-5B6/P.

notes: Applicable to ALL means all aircraft in the allocation table of this tailored manual, not every aircraft family named on the cover.
These tables do not directly apply to A320/CFM56-5B4, sharklet variants, NEO or Boeing.
The numerical grid is not an aircraft operating envelope or a statement that every tabulated mass is permitted for HC-CLF.

climb.boundary: Brake release to the selected flight level; includes takeoff and initial climb.
climb.massBasis: Weight at brake release; use the same starting mass for differences of cumulative levels.
climb.fuelBasis: Aircraft total; do not multiply by engine count or add a separate takeoff allowance.

conditions.speedProfile: 250 kt to FL100 from 1500 ft, acceleration to 300 kt, then 300 kt / M0.78

units.tasKt: KT, value printed in the table

sourceTables.extraction: Vector text assigned by cell coordinates; FL140 bottom line continues on PDF3206; visually checked against page images.
Raster table transcribed and checked against independent OCR and page images.

notes: There is no ISA0 climb table in this manual section. Do not extrapolate ISA+10/+20 to ISA0.
Missing cells near the ceiling remain absent: 11 at ISA+10 and 22 at ISA+20, including 78 t / FL330 at ISA+20.
A difference from the FL15 row represents climb above 1500 ft; the FL15 value includes takeoff and initial climb, not a pure ground-roll phase.
The TAS column is preserved as printed. It must not be assumed to be terminal cruise TAS without a source definition.
The correction percentages differ substantially between source tables of different content dates. No explanation is supplied here; no universal bleed factor is inferred or automatically applied.

descent.massBasis: Source labels WEIGHT without a more precise mass convention; treating it as top-of-descent mass requires an explicit modelling assumption.

conditions.thrust: IDLE THRUST, except the explicit N1=68.2 at 45t / FL390

units.n1Pct: percent, null when source says IDLE
units.n1Symbol: literal IDLE or null for numeric N1

notes: Descent ends at 1500 ft; approach and landing are separate phases.
FUEL (KG) is a phase quantity, not FF/ENG. It is not multiplied by the engine count.
350 ft/min is the maximum CABIN rate of descent, not the aircraft vertical speed.
No indicative qualifier for N1 is printed on this source table or PER-DES-GEN; IDLE text is preserved separately, never converted to zero N1.
FL15 source values .0 / 0 / 0 are true zeros. No missing numerical cells; no interpolation or extrapolation included.

holding.massBasis: Tabulated aircraft weight for instantaneous flow; planning guidance uses weight at landing at the alternate.

metadata.extractionMethod: Manual transcription from embedded table image; all rows checked against independent OCR after removing grid lines for OCR only. Original images preserved separately.
metadata.title: RACE TRACK HOLDING PATTERN - GREEN DOT SPEED
notes: General text says total fuel flow; the numerical table unambiguously labels FF (KG/H/ENG). Use two engines for aircraft total fuel flow.
ISA +/-15 degrees applicability is not stated on PER-HLD-GEN or this table. Only ISA and a correction per degree ABOVE ISA are stated.
No missing numerical cells in the 17 x 8 grid. No interpolation or extrapolation included.
These are source planning allowances for the stated profile, not universal constants for other aircraft.
Printed rounded fuel quantities and printed flow times duration are not forced to be arithmetically identical.
Alternate planning starts with a go-around, not brake release. The main-trip cumulative climb table does not by itself define alternate fuel.
The worked example on PDF3178 is explicitly for A320-232 and not the actual aircraft; its example tables are excluded from this dataset.

useStatus.purpose: Source-specific reference and diagnostic lookup, not an automatic mission-model replacement.
useStatus.interpolation: Linear between available neighbouring nodes in mass/FL/temperature; no extrapolation and no filling missing corners. Source corrections are metadata only.
